RECIPE CARD - EF-210 epoxy floor coating - Part A
Document: EF-210 epoxy floor coating - Part A
Revision: Rev 2, effective 08/02/1999.
Steps
1. Run D-1 empty 5 min before charging (see WI-1997-02).
2. Pre-heat all epoxy resin drums in hot box HB-1, 40 °C, 12 h.
3. Charge 430 kg liquid epoxy resin ALTAREP E-19 (Resine Altamira).
4. Add 40 kg reactive diluent; mix 10 min.
5. Add 250 kg quartz flour and 20 kg micro-silica.
6. Add 2.4 kg silicone defoamer.
7. Sample; EEW 190-210 g/eq.
8. Fill 20 kg pails on FL-2, close and label.
Change note
Added hot box pre-heating of resin drums (CR-1999-002).
